div.p:
A STAND-IN OBJECT THAT SHARES THE REAL SUBJECT'S INTERFACE AND
CONTROLS ACCESS TO IT. THE CLIENT BELIEVES IT IS TALKING TO THE
REAL THING; THE PROXY ADDS CACHING, ROUTING, PROTECTION, OR
INDIRECTION BEFORE DELEGATING.

ul.li:
SD-NOTES/TOOLS/REVERSE_PROXY.D2 — THE REVERSE PROXY TERMINATES
SSL, ROUTES, AND RATE-LIMITS ON BEHALF OF THE WEB/API SERVERS.

SD-NOTES/TOOLS/CDN.D2 — EDGE NODES ARE GEOGRAPHIC CACHING
PROXIES FOR THE ORIGIN SERVER.

SD-NOTES/DESIGNS/MINT.D2 — THE WEB SERVER FRONTS THE INTERNAL
SERVICES RATHER THAN EXPOSING THEM.

SELF/SETUP.D2 — THE VITE DEV SERVER PROXIES /TECH/** AND
*.SVG THROUGH TO SERVER.JS.
